ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies resolve polyploid origins and trait variation in plants
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and haplotype-resolved assemblies now span soybean, sesame, buckwheat, wheatgrass, Madhuca, and Aceraceae, linking variation to function.

ranked.headline: Graph and transport methods resolve cell-state structure in single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies graph, transport, and information-bottleneck methods to single-cell and spatial omics, with scMagnifier adding in silico perturbation.

ranked.headline: Neighborhood topology and bias-aware statistics resolve single-cell tissue architecture
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets increasingly demand neighborhood-aware, bias-corrected statistics to interpret tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Reduced physical models link protein sequence, structure, and conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Reduced representations and short MD sampling are being applied to mutational, binding, folding, and transition landscapes at once.

ranked.headline: Latent diffusion and VAE models generate and denoise single-cell transcriptome states
ranked.summary: Preprints now combine masked discrete diffusion, latent diffusion transformers, and VAEs with flow matching for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic inference errors under violated assumptions and proposed corrections
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test how tree-based inference fails when model assumptions break, and propose diagnostics and corrections for those failures.

ranked.headline: Computational resources for bacterial genomics, metagenomics and phage transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Open platforms now provide automated or interactive access to large, uniformly processed bacterial, phage and microbiome genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Network and association methods rank candidate functions from paired multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Paired multi-omic and perturbation data are increasingly combined with network priors, and most such tools are still preprints.

ranked.headline: Long-read genomes and methylomes resolve variant, promoter and NMD regulatory effects
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now resolves diploid haplotypes, promoter methylation and allele-specific NMD effects across human and vertebrate genomes.

ranked.headline: K-mer indexing enables assembly and phylogenetic inference from raw sequencing reads
ranked.summary: New k-mer-based tools span long-read metagenome assembly, low-coverage phylogenomics, and pangenome genotyping directly from reads.

ranked.headline: Deep learning on DNA and protein sequence predicts regulatory and interaction outcomes
ranked.summary: Foundation and deep models now predict perturbation responses, regulatory activity and phage-bacteria interactions directly from sequence and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Mapping cell identity and 3D tissue architecture across scales
ranked.summary: A 59M-cell whole-mouse atlas and scalable cell-type assignment tools extend single-cell reference mapping to tissues and cell lines.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein localization, binding affinity and phase separation
ranked.summary: Protein language models and AlphaFold-derived methods are extended to proteome-scale and binding prediction, mostly as unreviewed preprints.

ranked.headline: Deep learning fusion of pathology, genomics and MRI for cancer outcome prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether added modalities and debiasing improve TCGA survival and biomarker prediction; one finds additive, not synergistic, gains.

ranked.headline: Tools unify gene identifiers, genome track formats, and m6A and proteomics analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible, open-source tools now target identifier mismatches, format barriers, and non-model species analysis across genomics and proteomics.

ranked.headline: Bioinformatics tools for microbial genomics, metagenomics, and sequencing workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints present automated pipelines for lineage calling, methylation profiling, demultiplexing, and reuse of microbiome sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Constraint-based genome-scale models coupled to learning and bioreactor simulation
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair genome-scale flux models with machine learning, neural surrogates and bioreactor simulation for prediction and optimisation.

ranked.headline: Simulations couple cell mechanics, cytoplasm, and tissue structure to experiments
ranked.summary: Recent reviews and new methods, including simulations reaching 200 microseconds, sharpen models of crowded cellular environments.

ranked.headline: Complete and pangenome-scale genome assemblies across viruses, primates and fungi
ranked.summary: Telomere-to-telomere and pangenome-level assemblies now resolve centromeres, rDNA, MHC and structural variation across taxa.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of regulatory variation to cell and tissue phenotypes
ranked.summary: Locus-level and AI-assisted methods now link genetic variation to regulatory and tissue-level readouts across human and animal models.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and multi-omic models predict cancer outcomes and miRNA-disease links
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark biomarker selection and survival models across censored and multi-omic cancer data, alongside a graph-based miRNA-disease predictor.

ranked.headline: Learning-based methods for selection scans, imputation, and genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks learning-based genomic inference under demographic uncertainty and reference-panel dependence.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and fine-mapping methods refine detection of regulatory and causal variants
ranked.summary: Bayesian posterior inference now underpins population-scale reporter, trio allelic imbalance, and multi-trait colocalisation analyses.

ranked.headline: Model-derived brain-state and aging readouts for neuromodulation and dementia diagnosis
ranked.summary: Foundation and deep learning models now yield intervention-sensitive brain aging and neuromodulation readouts, with one published dementia diagnostic study.

ranked.headline: Physics and preference objectives steer generative docking, design and folding models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply reinforcement learning and preference optimization to diffusion docking, inverse folding, and molecular design.

ranked.headline: Protein language models predict disorder, binding sites, and mutation effects
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings are now paired with graph, transformer, and diffusion architectures across disorder, binding, and affinity tasks.

ranked.headline: Simulation and network methods map how perturbations shift protein conformational states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply trajectory representations, topology-geometry decoupling and H-bond networks to conformational transitions in proteins and ribosomes.

ranked.headline: Flow and topology frameworks model health, brain-network and multiome dynamics
ranked.summary: Wearable, brain, and plant time-series data are now modeled as flows on graphs, topological complexes, and Koopman operators.

ranked.headline: Modular tools standardize spatial and isoform transcriptomics analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Spatial, isoform-resolved, and nanopore datasets require analysis software that runs reproducibly across environments and hardware.

ranked.headline: Physical context and template pruning refine peptide, antibody, and ligand docking
ranked.summary: Docking and structure prediction workflows are incorporating template pruning, stability assessment, and integrated docking-to-MD handoff in current work.

ranked.headline: Total RNA profiling joins coding and noncoding transcripts in single cells
ranked.summary: TotalX extends total RNA profiling to droplet single-cell platforms, and new circadian tools now operate on single-cell and tissue transcriptomes.

ranked.headline: Learned models automate sequence annotation, alignment filtering, and homology search
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair learned models, structure tokens, and vector retrieval with core sequence analysis steps.

ranked.headline: Trio exome analysis and federated variant sharing for rare-disease genomics
ranked.summary: Stepwise clinical implementation of rare-disease genome sequencing is being paired with local trio analysis and privacy-compliant federated variant sharing.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold predictions expand to proteome-scale dimers and domain-level classification
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale structure resources now include 31M predicted dimers and domain classifications for 542,000 Swiss-Prot AlphaFold models.

ranked.headline: EEG Measures Track Cortical Network Stability in Emotion, Parkinson's and BCI States
ranked.summary: Model-based EEG descriptors now link cortical network stability and oscillatory dynamics to affective, Parkinsonian and motor-imagery states.

ranked.headline: Joint inference of cell lineage trees, genotypes, and migration histories
ranked.summary: Single-cell lineage trees from editing barcodes and tracing data now support joint genotype, migration, and age-structured phylodynamic inference.

ranked.headline: Model-free and calibrated statistical frameworks for quality and inference in biological data
ranked.summary: Benchmarked, calibrated, and model-free metrics are standardizing quality assessment and inference across structural and transcriptomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational tools refine peptide identification and spectral library generation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address FDR estimation, timsTOF library generation, open PTM search, and benchmark design in proteomics workflows.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools quantify drift, tracking, and detection in microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release reusable open-source imaging pipelines for drift correction, tracking, and detection.

ranked.headline: Compact biological models match larger foundation models across imaging and genomics
ranked.summary: Compression and efficiency gains are now being tested across microscopy, mRNA, and single-cell transcriptomic foundation models.
